user.title: Energy flows
user.description: Inverter sensors. Enter grid and battery either as one signed entity or as a pair of positive entities (e.g. Growatt: import + export, charge + discharge). Power in W or kW.

data_description.grid_power: Leave empty when import and export are entered separately.
data_description.grid_import_positive: Single entity only: turn off if it reports import as negative.
data_description.battery_power: Leave empty when charge and discharge are entered separately.
data_description.battery_charge_positive: Single entity only: turn off if it reports charging as negative.
data_description.house_power: Total house consumption (e.g. Growatt local load). Managed devices are subtracted automatically. Without an import entity it is also used to compute the import.
data_description.grid_import_power: Positive while importing. When missing it is computed from house load, export, PV and battery.

battery.title: Battery and forecast
battery.description: The battery has priority up to the target SoC. With the target from the time without production the target is computed to cover the evening and night. When the forecast until sunset covers charging and the house load, the target is lowered so devices get surplus earlier.

data.forecast_min_soc: Target SoC when the forecast is sufficient

data_description.forecast_safety_factor: 1.3 = the forecast must promise 30% more than needed (margin for forecast error).
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Usable capacity of the home battery.
data_description.battery_target_soc: Upper bound. With the target from the time without production the actual target is usually lower.
data_description.forecast_min_soc: Lower target used when the forecast until sunset covers charging the battery and the house load. Devices get surplus earlier and the battery charges later.
data_description.house_avg_power_w: Average power in W (typically 400–800 W), not daily energy in kWh. Without managed devices. Used only when no house consumption sensor is set.
data_description.night_target: The battery has priority only up to the SoC that covers consumption from sunset to sunrise (+ reserve). Devices get the rest.
data_description.night_extra_hours: Hours added to the night – weak production after sunrise and before sunset.
data_description.battery_reserve_soc: SoC that should remain in the morning (minimum discharge).
data_description.battery_max_charge_w: How much the battery can take (W). While the battery has priority, devices only get surplus above this – running devices give way too.

control.title: Control

data.export_limit_reraise: Allow export again during the day
data.battery_borrow: Round up from a full battery

data_description.export_limit_entity: Number entity from the inverter integration. Raised while loads can take surplus so hidden surplus becomes visible.
data_description.phase_current_sensors: L1–L3 currents at the meter. Without them the breaker is not guarded.
data_description.reserve_w: Distribute this much less to avoid grid import.
data_description.nominal_voltage: Phase voltage used to convert current to power.
data_description.export_limit_raised: Value while devices take surplus, e.g. 100 % or 10000 W.
data_description.export_limit_control: On: the limit is raised once a day in the morning when something can store energy and the forecast promises surplus beyond the house and battery; lowered only when nothing can store (battery full, boiler hot, car charged/away). It is not touched in the evening. Off: the limit stays as you set it.
data_description.export_limit_reraise: After lowering, raise the limit again the same day when storage appears (e.g. the car arrives). Off = at most once a day (fewer inverter writes).
data_description.battery_full_soc: From this SoC the battery counts as full (stores nothing more).
data_description.battery_borrow: When the battery is full, devices are rounded to the nearest step – the car by 1 A, the boiler starts at half its power. The battery covers the difference instead of exporting. Borrowing stops 5 % below full, then the battery recharges.
data_description.input_timeout_s: When no inverter data (grid, battery, SoC) arrives for this long, surplus devices are stopped. Deadlines continue. 0 = off.
data_description.dry_run: The integration computes, logs and shows decisions but switches nothing and writes no export limit. For trying it on a real installation.

control.description: Export limits use the same unit as the inverter's limit entity (W, kW or %). Selected entity: {export_unit}.

hdo.title: HDO – low tariff
hdo.description: Where to get the low-tariff times. Used by boiler deadline heating (HDO only) and diagnostics.

hdo_egd.title: HDO – EG.D
hdo_egd.description: Find the HDO code on the HDO receiver, the meter or egd.cz. Enter it as A1B4DP5, or a command code (e.g. 405, Cd56 for smart meters).

hdo_pre.title: HDO – PRE
hdo_pre.description: Find the HDO command (povel) in Moje PRE or on the HDO receiver.

hdo_calendar.title: HDO – calendar
hdo_calendar.description: Calendar whose events are low-tariff windows (e.g. from the ČEZ Distribuce integration).

hdo_entity.title: HDO – entity
hdo_entity.description: Entity that is on during the low tariff. Future windows are unknown, so every HDO window is used.

hdo_manual.title: HDO – manual times
hdo_manual.description: Low-tariff times, e.g. 00:00-06:00; 14:00-17:00. Public holidays count as weekend.

error.raised_not_above_normal: The raised limit must be higher than the normal one.
error.raised_too_low_watts: The limit entity is in W. A raised limit below 1000 W reveals almost nothing; it should probably be e.g. 10000.
error.egd_code_not_found: EG.D has no schedule for this HDO code and PSČ.
error.egd_unknown_psc: EG.D does not know this PSČ.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the distributor, try again.
error.pre_povel_not_found: PRE returned no schedule for this command.
error.grid_source: Enter grid power, or import and export, or export + house load + PV power (import is computed).
error.battery_source: Enter either battery power, or both charge and discharge.

data_description.power_sensor: Detects that the boiler thermostat cut off and offers the power to others.
data_description.max_temperature: The boiler is heated from surplus up to this temperature (energy storage). Independent of the deadline temperature.
data_description.on_margin_w: Surplus must exceed the power by this much to turn on.
data_description.off_tolerance_w: How much may be missing (grid import / battery discharge) before turning off.
data_description.deadline_enabled: If the water will not reach the temperature by the given time, the boiler is topped up without surplus (in HDO or just before the deadline). Needs a temperature sensor.
data_description.tank_volume_l: Used to compute when to start heating.
data_description.deadline_hysteresis: Deadline heating starts only when the water is at least this much below the target.
data_description.max_temperature_hysteresis: After reaching the maximum, surplus heating resumes only after the water cools by this much.
data_description.deadline_hdo_only: On: what the solar forecast will not cover is heated from the grid only in low tariff – in the latest HDO windows before the deadline. Off: just before the deadline at any time.
data_description.deadline_earliest: Optional safeguard: no grid heating before this time. 00:00 = no limit (recommended with a forecast – the plan picks the latest windows anyway).
data_description.legionella_enabled: Once per interval heats the water to the anti-legionella temperature – preferably from surplus (temporarily raises the maximum), with deadline heating also in HDO / before the deadline. The boiler thermostat must allow this temperature.
data_description.legionella_interval_days: Days after the last time the temperature was reached.
data_description.minimum_before_battery: Until the minimum is reached (deadline temperature / minimum car SoC), surplus goes here before the home battery. Avoids charging the battery only to discharge it into the boiler or car in the evening.
